name.value: White Rock Sea Tours and Whale Watch Vancouver

description.value: White Rock Sea Tours is a family-owned marine tour company operating from Crescent Beach Marina in Surrey, roughly 30 minutes south of Vancouver. They run small-group Zodiac expeditions to the Canadian Gulf Islands and US San Juan Islands in search of orcas, humpbacks, sea lions, and seabirds, with a 100% whale sighting guarantee from April to October. Beyond whale watching, they offer sea lion tours, sunset cruises, private charters, and ash scattering ceremonies along the BC coastline.

raw_osm.name: White Rock Sea Tours and Whale Watch Vancouver

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active whale watching and marine tour operation at Crescent Beach Marina in Surrey, BC, with Zodiac vessels that include onboard marine bathrooms per the Our Boats page. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, racks, water refill, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags. The OSM community tag reads 'Tsawwassen' but the website consistently identifies the location as Surrey/Crescent Beach, which are distinct communities.
concerns: OSM community tag lists 'Tsawwassen' but the business is located at Crescent Beach Marina in Surrey — these are distinct communities and the tag appears incorrect.
Street address (12555 Crescent Road) is not corroborated by the website, which refers only to 'Crescent Beach Marina, Surrey' without a street number.
Phone number (+1-604-868-1755) from OSM is not explicitly shown in the fetched website content and could not be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, clearly active marine tour attraction in the Crescent Beach area that a touring cyclist would find valuable as a destination experience; the marina is accessible by bike along the South Surrey coastal corridor.

Washrooms.detail: Marine bathroom on board each vessel; Our Boats page states 'onboard amenities – including a marine bathroom.' Land-based washrooms at the marina office are not explicitly mentioned

wow_evidence: Family zodiac whale-watching from Crescent Beach — operator ladder 2/3.
